verdict.rationale: Elastic's marketing pages claim two built-in AI capabilities: natural-language interaction with telemetry inside the product, and the 'nightshift AI SRE' that detects and investigates incidents and delivers root cause. Together these suggest users can hand off investigation work to an in-product AI. The support is limited to brief marketing claims, with no in-depth documentation or hands-on corroboration of what tasks can be delegated or how. missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on the assistant's delegable actions and workflows, scope of tasks beyond incident investigation, independent or hands-on verification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Interact directly with your telemetry through natural language and resolve problems faster without switching tabs or context.
Elastic nightshift AI SRE detects and investigates incidents, delivering evidence-backed root cause.
